extensionDescription.message: Claim GEOFlow work orders and safely fill drafts in websites where you are already signed in.

connectDescription.message: Enter your GEOFlow URL, then approve this browser in the admin console.

pairingHint.message: Verify the code in GEOFlow before approving access.

queueEmptyHint.message: Claimed work orders also remain visible here.

permissionDenied.message: Access to this site was not granted.

pairingExpired.message: The pairing code expired. Request a new one.

accountMissing.message: The work order has no assigned account.

activeTaskExists.message: Finish or release the current work order before opening another one.

targetMissing.message: The work order has no target URL.

pageLoadTimeout.message: The target page took too long to load.

replaceDraftConfirm.message: The editor already has content. Replace the current draft?

draftFilled.message: Draft filled. Review it and click Publish yourself.

resultUnknown.message: The result could not be confirmed. Verify it manually.

completionRequired.message: A result URL is required to confirm publication.

accountNotVerified.message: Verify the active Zhihu account by filling the draft before reporting this result.

copyFailed.message: Content could not be copied. Select and copy it manually.

wrong_platform.message: The active tab is not Zhihu.

wrong_target_page.message: The active page is not a Zhihu question.

human_verification_required.message: Complete the verification challenge in Zhihu before continuing.

account_mismatch.message: The current Zhihu account does not match the work order.

editor_not_found.message: The Zhihu answer editor was not found. The page may have changed.

editor_not_empty.message: The editor already contains a draft.

empty_content.message: The work order content is empty.

manualPlatformNote.message: Assisted manual publishing: open the editor, copy the title and body, review and publish yourself, then submit the publication receipt.
